What Carter's says to expect

  • Full year fiscal 2026: sales, profit and earningsFor fiscal year 2026 (a 52 week fiscal year), the Company projects approximately: • $2.91 billion to $2.93 billion in net sales ($2.898 billion in fiscal 2025, a 53 week fiscal year); • $178 million to $187 million in adjusted operating income, reflecting low-single digit to mid-single digit percentage growth ($176 million in fiscal 2025); • $3.05 to $3.23 in adjusted diluted earnings per share, reflecting a high-single digit to low-double digit percentage decline ($3.47 in fiscal 2025);
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 30, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
